description: Several teleports in one component: two side by side, in source order; nodes inserted before them, a conditional and a growing list; one in each row of a keyed list that reverses; and removing the component that holds them, which clears `body`.
requires: Every test reads what the component teleports, which mounts in the browser once the component has mounted: Astro, which runs nothing there, renders none of it (ADR-0098).
